verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix AI features generate root-cause analysis, automated triage, code fixes/PRs, and a Seer Agent that answers questions about telemetry directly inside the product, matching the AI-generated insights/suggestions story well. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and no community corroboration of the AI features specifically (community evidence covers only unrelated self-hosting topics).
